records.name: Namibia
records.summary_text:
Namibia demands real caution from trans visitors. Courts have delivered important rulings (the 2023 Digashu recognition of foreign same-sex marriages; earlier document-change wins for trans people), but same-sex conduct between men technically remains criminalised under the common law (the 2024 High Court declined to strike it, and parliament passed hostile marriage bills), and implementation of pro-LGBT rulings is documented as unsatisfactory (SALC). Windhoek has a small organised community (Equal Namibia); police are unhelpful rather than predatory.
